domain: incident triage: root-cause analysis from a page

how_to_score.recall_root_cause: An answer scores 1.0 if it names the mechanism in root_cause.summary. Cheap check: all of root_cause_must_include appear (case-insensitive, after simple stemming) in the answer, OR >=60% of root_cause_keywords appear. Score 0.5 for naming the correct proximate mechanism but the wrong originating change.
how_to_score.precision_evidence: Fraction of required_evidence entries the answer cites. Each entry's `match` is a literal substring that exists in the named artifact, so a scorer can verify the citation is real and not hallucinated. scoring.min_required_evidence is the pass bar.
how_to_score.red_herring_penalty: Subtract `penalty` for each red herring the answer asserts as a cause or a contributing factor. Merely mentioning and dismissing one is not penalised; asserting it is.
how_to_score.lens_appropriateness: precision = |proposed & lenses_warranted| / |proposed|; recall = |proposed & lenses_warranted| / |lenses_warranted|. Any lens in lenses_not_warranted that is proposed costs 1.0 as an explicit false positive. Lenses in neither list are neutral: they neither help nor hurt. This is the metric that must differ across incidents; if a system proposes the same lens set everywhere it will score well on two or three incidents and badly on the rest.
how_to_score.remediation: correct_remediation.immediate and .durable are separately scoreable. wrong_remediations lists fixes that address the symptom and leave the cause in place; asserting one is a failure even if the root cause was named correctly.

lens_vocabulary.name: Is the alert real?
lens_vocabulary.reads: monitor definition, threshold history, recent monitor changes

lens_vocabulary.name: Who is affected and who is not
lens_vocabulary.reads: per-pod / per-region / per-tenant / per-endpoint breakdowns

lens_vocabulary.name: Order of events
lens_vocabulary.reads: first-bad timestamp vs alert time vs change times

lens_vocabulary.name: What changed in the alert window
lens_vocabulary.reads: deploys.json inside the last few hours

lens_vocabulary.name: What changed days or weeks ago
lens_vocabulary.reads: deploys.json beyond the alert window, plus slow-moving metrics

lens_vocabulary.name: Can we undo it safely
lens_vocabulary.reads: deploy diffs, migration state, data written since

lens_vocabulary.name: Declared vs actual configuration
lens_vocabulary.reads: config change events, effective runtime config in logs

lens_vocabulary.name: Are our downstreams healthy
lens_vocabulary.reads: per-dependency latency and error series, topology edges

lens_vocabulary.name: Third parties
lens_vocabulary.reads: vendor status feeds, per-vendor latency, vendor error bodies

lens_vocabulary.name: CPU, memory, threads, event loop
lens_vocabulary.reads: utilisation vs limit, worker pool occupancy

lens_vocabulary.name: Bounded client-side pools
lens_vocabulary.reads: pool active/idle/pending, acquisition wait, timeouts

lens_vocabulary.name: Queues and consumer lag
lens_vocabulary.reads: lag, produce vs consume rate, DLQ rate

lens_vocabulary.name: Cache hit rate, key space, eviction
lens_vocabulary.reads: hit ratio, key count, memory, namespace, coalescing

lens_vocabulary.name: The database itself
lens_vocabulary.reads: query latency, plans, locks, vacuum, active backends

lens_vocabulary.name: Load we are creating ourselves
lens_vocabulary.reads: attempt histograms, retry policy, first-attempt vs total rate

lens_vocabulary.name: Replicas vs demand
lens_vocabulary.reads: replica count, HPA decisions, per-replica load

lens_vocabulary.name: Noisy neighbours and co-tenancy
lens_vocabulary.reads: node-level utilisation, cgroup throttling, scheduling events

lens_vocabulary.name: Name resolution and endpoints
lens_vocabulary.reads: lookup latency, NXDOMAIN, resolver health, endpoint lists

lens_vocabulary.name: Connectivity, TLS, load balancers
lens_vocabulary.reads: handshake errors, connection resets, per-hop error attribution

lens_vocabulary.name: Certificates, keys, tokens, secrets
lens_vocabulary.reads: notAfter dates, rotation events, handshake alerts

lens_vocabulary.name: Hostile or abusive traffic
lens_vocabulary.reads: source IP concentration, WAF events, failed-auth rate

lens_vocabulary.name: Time itself
lens_vocabulary.reads: NTP offset, log ordering, boundary times (midnight, month end)

lens_vocabulary.name: Shape of data crossing a boundary
lens_vocabulary.reads: schema versions, deserialisation errors, DLQ payloads

lens_vocabulary.name: Allocation over long horizons
lens_vocabulary.reads: RSS trend over days, GC behaviour, heap retainers, OOM kills

lens_vocabulary.name: Is demand actually different
lens_vocabulary.reads: request rate vs the same hour yesterday, unique-actor counts

lens_vocabulary.name: What we cannot see
lens_vocabulary.reads: missing series, unsampled paths, the question no artifact answers
